text_block_list.text: I don't know why, but I feel like...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: I feel like I can do really well today.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, what am I saying? C'mon, Nature!
Don't jinx
it!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Don't make it worse! I'm just feeling
good is all...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But don't get your hopes up too high.
Just... If it
goes well, it goes well!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
